grammatica.evidence: Fixed template across entries: "Integer, default `6`."; "Enum, default `\"mat\"`. One of..."; "Boolean, default `true`." — stock config-reference English.

dialectica.evidence: Type/default never argued, only asserted ("Integer, default `6`"). Behavioral asides (fail-closed, deferred window) unused for pure type+default lookup.

rhetorica.evidence: Preamble "Every setting below shows its default"; lead each key with type+default before gloss; three tables chosen/ordered [rack]→[watering]→[alerts].

arithmetica.evidence: Ten non-public claims: rows int/6, cells_per_row int/8, mode enum mat|top|manual, window [07:00,09:00], channel log|email|none, quiet_hours [21:00,06:00], etc.

geometria.evidence: H2 per TOML table (`## [rack]`), H3 per setting (`### rows`), one H4 nest (`#### humidity_threshold`) — jump-to-leaf layout over tables/prose dump.

musica.evidence: Local beat: stressed type-default clause, then short gloss ("Integer, default `6`. Rows the planner may use."). Parallel cadence on every leaf.

astronomia.evidence: Flat catalog arc: file rule → rack → watering → alerts; no crescendo. Global order secondary to random-access headings for the lookup telos.

notes: Telos is single-setting type+default lookup; geometria/rhetorica carry the scannability, arithmetica the non-public payload.
